articles.title: Revolut hackers demand $3 million in Monero, threaten to sell customer data
articles.snippet: The group gave Revolut 24 hours to pay and said it targeted customers with significant crypto holdings.

articles.title: Bitcoin's Coinbase premium sinks to one-month low, here’s why
articles.snippet: Weakening U.S. demand, a setback for the Clarity act and expectations of a fed rate hike weigh on bitcoin.

articles.title: Ethereum, Base give up on common wallet standard after months of talks
articles.snippet: Ethereum is moving ahead with EIP-8141 while Coinbase-backed Base backs EIP-8130, leaving wallets and apps that span both networks facing different transaction systems.

articles.title: Bitcoin Coinbase Premium hits monthly low as CLARITY Act vote squeezes US demand
articles.snippet: Bitcoin exchange demand on Coinbase declined after the US Senate voted against the CLARITY Act, while traders sent BTC to exchanges at an unrealized loss.

articles.title: ECB seeks online merchants for 2027 digital euro pilot
articles.snippet: Euro-area online and mobile merchants can apply until Oct. 27 to test beta digital euro payments in a 12-month pilot.
